reels.caption:
Islam Makhachev vence por decisão x Ian Gary Machado UFC 330. 

Islam beats Ian Gary in a decision. 

#iangarybrasil #is
good: Professional UFC branding and production quality establish credibility instantly
Clear hook with fighter names and match context in overlay from frame 1
High-emotion post-match celebration creates memorable victory moment
Strong visual composition with arena, crowd, and championship belt draws the eye
bad: Decision victory is inherently less shareable than knockout/submission – lacks dramatic payoff
Heavy post-match content early misses opportunity to show fight action that hooks viewers in first 3s
No visible call-to-action despite 3.6% engagement – leaves shares and saves on the table
Very low save rate (15) indicates content doesn't stick as memorable or rewatch-worthy
reels.top_tip: Lead with the most dramatic fight action or close exchange in the first 3 seconds rather than jumping straight to celebration – decision victories need fight footage to build narrative tension and make the outcome feel earned, not just announced

reels.caption:
Mackenzie Dern vence em decisao x Gillisn Robertson. UFC 330
Mackenzie wins over a decision x Gillian Robertson 

#savag
good: Dynamic action hook shows UFC fight immediately—clear, professional production quality
Strong emotional payoff with celebration and championship belt at end—highly shareable moment
Multiple story beats (action → decision → celebration) maintain interest throughout
Clean text overlays and UFC branding provide context and platform trust
bad: Engagement rate 2.8% is below ideal for Reels (target 3.5%+)—hook lacks emotional urgency
Save rate extremely low (3 saves from 8k views)—no clear reason for viewers to keep/return
No call-to-action (like, follow, share)—leaves engagement on table
Champion celebration buried at end instead of upfront—strongest moment should open video

Lucas Fernando KO’s Rafael Tobias 
#ufc330 
#lucasfernandomma #novauniao #peacegrappler
good: Strong immediate action in hook—fighter throwing punch is scroll-stopping and on-brand for combat sports
Clear text overlay naming the KO early ('LUCA FERNANDO KO'S RAFAEL TOBIAS') anchors viewer attention
Professional production quality with UFC branding and cage visibility builds credibility
Solid average watch time (5.8s)—hook successfully holds viewers past early scroll point
bad: Zero saves despite 388 views—content isn't compelling enough for bookmarking or reference
Extremely low shares (1)—poor virality for combat content, suggests missing shareability trigger
No visible call-to-action or engagement prompt ('tag your training partner,' 'who would win?') to drive saves
Hook shows fighting setup/lead punch rather than the knockout impact itself—the payoff moment may not land hard enough
reels.top_tip: Lead the hook with the actual knockout impact (not the setup punch) and add an engagement call-to-action text overlay to drive saves and shares

reels.caption:
Jack Della Maddalena preve Islam x Gary no UFC 330. 

JDM preview of Islam Makhachev x Ian Gary this weekend at UFC 330.
good: Close-up face hook immediately captures personality and credibility for fight predictions
Clear UFC branding and event context (UFC 330) from overlaid text — viewers know the category instantly
Strong retention: 5.9s average watch time shows audience stays engaged through the full video
Content variety: transitions from talking head to weigh-in footage for visual interest and proof
bad: Text-heavy hook in Portuguese limits reach beyond Portuguese speakers — English subtitles needed for broader audience
No call-to-action or engagement hook — content informs but doesn't ask viewers to predict, comment, or save
Zero shares and saves despite decent watch time — indicates content isn't sticky or valuable enough to keep
Assumes audience already follows JDM — doesn't hook casual MMA fans with stakes, question, or entertainment angle
reels.top_tip: Add a direct CTA asking viewers to predict the outcome or drop their take in comments — hooks on audience engagement and emotional investment, not just information delivery, which unlocks saves and shares

reels.caption:
3 top KO e TKO’s do UFC 330. 
Concorda ou teve melhor? 

Top 3 KO and TKO’s for UFC 330 Islam Makhachev x Ian Machado Ga
good: Strong hook with action-packed opening and UFC 330 branding—immediately establishes topic and stops scroll
Numbered ranking format (1, 3 visible) creates curiosity loop that encourages full watch
High production quality with clean graphics, professional overlay, and bilingual captions extend reach
4.7s average watch time shows decent hook retention for a fight clip
bad: Zero saves and 1 share on 410 views—content lacks save-worthiness and shareability
Missing #2 fighter makes ranking feel incomplete; viewers may assume video is cut short
CTA ('Concorda ou teve melhor?') only in caption, not on-screen—biggest miss for engagement
Reach (263) is only 64% of views—algorithm isn't amplifying; grammar issues in bilingual captions may hurt reach
reels.top_tip: Add on-screen call-to-action text ("Who's #2? Comment below" or "Vote in comments") superimposed over the ranking, and make sure all three KOs are shown clearly with personality labels ("BRUTAL", "CLEAN", "FLYING KNEE") to drive saves and comments

good: Immediate facial hook: JDM's face fills frame with skeptical expression—stops scroll instantly
